_comment: Section detection rules. Values are data, not code: correcting a renamed tab is a file change, not a release. Resource ids below are the best available information and MUST be validated on a device with each app version before relying on them; a wrong id simply never matches, it does not block the wrong screen. SELECTED_TAB is used for tabs because the tab's icon/label is present on every tab, so mere presence proves nothing.
